name: Hakase (Simple)
reference: User-supplied screenshot highlighting a green-haired scientist on its right side. Green hair, forehead goggles and scientist-coat cues were used for an original simplified chibi; no exact source-character identity is asserted. The screenshot itself is not included in this package.
brief: Predominantly green, compact readable full-body scientist with broad green hair locks, expressive green eyes, oversized mint goggles, a plain ivory coat, forest-green tunic and simple dark boots. Remove fiddly costume details. Rich state-specific acting through limbs, expression, anticipation, head movement and hair/coat follow-through; no detached decorative effects.
processing: Bundled work-pets 0.1.6 preparation, connected-pose extraction, frame inspection, atlas composition, cardinal extraction, shared look registration, despill, structural/quality validation and direction review. Additional deterministic registration applies one uniform scale/ground transform to all frames of each standard row; horizontal profiles inherit idle scale. Generated pet pixels are not manually drawn. Source art uses genuine alpha; the single magenta-key despill pass uses strength 0 to preserve its greens while clearing hidden RGB. Final PNG encoding is lossless. GIFs use a shared palette, no dithering and alpha threshold 128.
